16:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The Temple Owls (2-9, 1-6 American) take on the Memphis Tigers (8-3, 5-2) at Simmons Bank Liberty Stadium. Temple seeks to snap a six-game skid after falling 31-27 to Rice. Memphis snapped a three-game win streak with a 38-34 loss to Navy.
